description: Creates and manages a scheduled report for an AWS Billing and Cost Management Dashboards dashboard. A scheduled report renders a snapshot of the dashboard on a cron schedule, using an IAM role that the service assumes to read the underlying cost and usage data.

ScheduleExpression.description: The schedule expression that specifies when to trigger the scheduled report run. This value must be a cron expression consisting of six fields separated by white spaces: cron(minutes hours day_of_month month day_of_week year).
ScheduleExpression.markdownDescription:
The schedule expression that specifies when to trigger the scheduled report run. This value must be a cron expression consisting of six fields separated by white spaces: cron(minutes hours day_of_month month day_of_week year).
